t: Juno Dawson Books | Waterstones
s: Born in Bradford, Juno graduated from Bangor University and became a primary school teacher and PSHE co-ordinator. Whilst working as a teacher she penned a series of YA novels whose success enabled her to leave teaching to write full-time. In 2014, This Book is Gay, Dawson’s groundbreaking ‘manual to all areas of life as an LGBT person’ caused a furore in the United States where it was banned from a school library in Alaska for its ‘profanity and sexually explicit text.’ In the same year, she became a School Role Model for Stonewall and was also a recipient of the Queen of Teen award.
